_handoff.scope: Additive public first-person Bengaluru accounts relevant to failures or recovery gaps in seeking a BESCOM new or permanent electricity connection. These are case evidence only, not official eligibility, building-rule, fee, route, deadline, complaint, or service-level evidence. Usernames, names, precise locations, property characteristics, account/request numbers, contact details, and amounts are intentionally omitted. Differing accounts are retained without resolving them.

sources.title: Need advice: Stuck without permanent electricity due to G+3 rule enforcement in Bangalore
sources.notes: The author describes their own completed building, reports having had a temporary BESCOM connection during construction, and says permanent meters were denied. They attribute the outcome to a stated building-rule enforcement issue and report no clear path forward; neither attribution nor policy is verified.

sources.title: BESCOM New connection with meter
sources.notes: A commenter describes their own newly constructed building and reports it remained without electricity after completion, while linking the difficulty to a building-height deviation. The post does not establish the application route, actual decision-maker, violation, charge, or outcome.

claims.text: One citizen reported having temporary BESCOM supply during construction but being unable to obtain permanent meters after construction completion.
claims.notes: One self-report. It does not establish that a permanent-connection application was complete, that temporary supply confers a right to permanent supply, the cited reason, or a BESCOM policy or delay. No recovery outcome was reported.

claims.text: One citizen reported that their completed newly constructed building still lacked electricity while they were seeking a new connection and meter.
claims.notes: One commenter self-report. The commenter associates the problem with a building condition, but the case does not establish any requirement, payment, application status, assessment, or completion outcome.

roadblocks.title: Reported permanent-meter outcome gap after temporary supply
roadblocks.symptom: A citizen reports that permanent meters were not obtained after construction despite earlier temporary supply.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; the account cannot establish the route, application completeness, building condition, utility decision, inspection state, or policy applicability.
roadblocks.recovery: No recovery outcome was reported. Use an authorised application reference to request the current case status and a case-specific missing-condition reason; do not rely on the poster's rule interpretation.

roadblocks.title: Reported new-meter outcome gap for completed building
roadblocks.symptom: A citizen reports a completed new building still lacked electricity while they sought a new connection and meter.
roadblocks.likelyCause: Unknown; the account does not distinguish application route, documents, inspection, building condition, network work, payment, or any decision.
roadblocks.recovery: No recovery outcome was reported. Confirm the case-specific status and any deficiency through an authorised BESCOM channel; do not infer a general building-condition rule from the account.
